section.name: What is a Scope's SComponent?
section.p: SComponents are subclasses of standard Swing components (or objects) with the addition of data binding methods to map SComponents to data in the Scope model class.

Generally, there are some common steps to use each different type of SComponent (SButton is an exception to these steps):
In the Model: Provide a getData method to return the data object for the SComponent to bind to. Scope actually maps SComponents to get methods according to the JavaBeans convention.
In the View: Create the SComponent.
In the View: Call the "setSelector" methods on the SComponent to bind it to the data in the model.
(Optional) In the View: Call the "setControlID" methods on the SComponent to issue a Control to the bound Controller when the user performs an action with this component.
